The Terrifying 'Glitch' Where Your Mind Wakes Up Trapped

Imagine waking up, completely conscious, but unable to move or speak, often seeing terrifying hallucinations. This isn't a nightmare; it's sleep paralysis. Uncover the chilling science behind this 'mind-awake, body-asleep' phenomenon. 😱 What's the strangest thing you've ever experienced during sleep?
